name: Freshdesk
oneLiner: Freshworks' AI-powered helpdesk for ticketing across email, chat, phone and social, with Freddy AI agents, copilot and insights. Freshdesk Omni is the omnichannel edition.
bestFor: Small and mid-size teams that want an affordable multichannel helpdesk with AI self-service they can grow into.

updates.text: At Refresh, Freshworks launched the Freshdesk Command Center (one workspace for multichannel conversations with Freddy AI Copilot built in), Vertical AI Agents for ecommerce, fintech, travel and logistics with 50+ prebuilt workflows in Freddy AI Agent Studio, and Freddy AI Insights.
Freddy AI Agent Studio, a no-code tool to build, test and monitor AI agents.

features: Ticketing from email, chat, phone and social in one inbox
Freddy AI Agent for automated answers on chat and email, built in AI Agent Studio
Freddy AI Copilot: summaries, suggested replies and next actions (add-on on Pro and Enterprise)
Freddy AI Insights for trends and anomaly alerts
Automations for assignment, SLAs and follow-ups
Team collaboration with private notes, shared ownership and parent-child tickets
Integrations such as Shopify, Stripe and FedEx for order lookups

pricing.text: Growth $19, Pro $55 and Enterprise $89 per agent per month, billed annually. Freddy AI Copilot is an add-on; AI Agent sessions are sold in packs.

notes: freshworks.com could not be fetched from this session; prices come from a search of the official pricing page (snippet) and match several 2026 third-party guides, which say prices rose in 2026 from $15/$49/$79. The free plan (original said up to 10 agents) is no longer clearly offered; sources conflict, so it is left out. Dineout case study is hosted on third-party sites (iotone), not freshworks.com. Original 'reducing manual workload significantly' dropped.
